mapper.select: select id, registration_no as registrationNo, captain_user_id as captainUserId, track_code as trackCode, team_name as teamName, work_title as workTitle, work_summary as workSummary, statement_truth as statementTruth, statement_eligibility as statementEligibility, statement_copyright as statementCopyright, status, submitted_at as submittedAt, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from xfc_2026_registration where captain_user_id = #{captainUserId} and status = 'DRAFT' order by updated_at desc, id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into xfc_2026_registration (captain_user_id, track_code, team_name, work_title, work_summary, statement_truth, statement_eligibility, statement_copyright, status) values (#{captainUserId}, #{trackCode}, #{teamName}, #{workTitle}, #{workSummary}, #{statementTruth}, #{statementEligibility}, #{statementCopyright}, 'DRAFT')
mapper.update: update xfc_2026_registration set track_code=#{trackCode}, team_name=#{teamName}, work_title=#{workTitle}, work_summary=#{workSummary}, statement_truth=#{statementTruth}, statement_eligibility=#{statementEligibility}, statement_copyright=#{statementCopyright} where id=#{id} and captain_user_id=#{captainUserId} and status='DRAFT'
mapper.select: select id, role, user_id as userId, student_no as studentNo, name, college, major, class_name as className, phone, sort_no as sortNo from xfc_2026_member where registration_id=#{registrationId} order by sort_no
select id, name, organization, title, phone, email, sort_no as sortNo from xfc_2026_advisor where registration_id=#{registrationId} order by sort_no
mapper.insert: insert into xfc_2026_member (registration_id, role, user_id, student_no, name, college, major, class_name, phone, sort_no) values (#{registrationId}, #{role}, #{userId}, #{studentNo}, #{name}, #{college}, #{major}, #{className}, #{phone}, #{sortNo})
insert into xfc_2026_advisor (registration_id, name, organization, title, phone, email, sort_no) values (#{registrationId}, #{name}, #{organization}, #{title}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{sortNo})
mapper.update: update xfc_2026_registration set registration_no=#{registrationNo} where id=#{id} and registration_no is null
mapper.select: select id, material_type as materialType, original_filename as originalFilename, file_url as fileUrl, file_size as fileSize, content_type as contentType, uploaded_at as uploadedAt from xfc_2026_material where registration_id=#{registrationId} order by field(material_type, 'APPLICATION', 'PRESENTATION', 'SUPPLEMENT')

select id, material_type as materialType, original_filename as originalFilename, file_url as fileUrl, file_size as fileSize, content_type as contentType, uploaded_at as uploadedAt from xfc_2026_material where registration_id=#{registrationId} and material_type=#{materialType}
mapper.insert: insert into xfc_2026_material (registration_id, material_type, original_filename, file_url, file_size, content_type) values (#{registrationId}, #{materialType}, #{originalFilename}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileSize}, #{contentType}) on duplicate key update original_filename=values(original_filename), file_url=values(file_url), file_size=values(file_size), content_type=values(content_type), uploaded_at=current_timestamp
